media.label: Media
media.description: External media such as cutscene archive videos for content that has been removed

lore-book.label: Lore Book
lore-book.description: Short stories that may be found in-game in the Character screen under "Collections > Lore"

quest.label: Quest
quest.description: Campaigns or other series of missions found in the "Quests" tab

timeline-mission.label: Timeline Mission
timeline-mission.description: Individual mission that may be found in the Director inside the "Timeline"

mission.label: Mission
mission.description: Other standalone missions or activities that may be found in the Director under "Vanguard Ops"

dungeon.label: Dungeon
dungeon.description: Advanced activity for 1-3 players found in the Director under "Raids and Dungeons"

raid.label: Raid
raid.description: Difficult activity for 6 players found in the Director under "Raids and Dungeons"

releases.title: Destiny
releases.synopsis:
You are a Guardian of The Last City; a soldier able to wield some of The Traveler's incredible power. Since the Collapse centuries ago Humanity has slowly started to rebuild, but new enemies have found their way towards us across the stars and are already threatening what little we have.

If you can find a way to save the City and help to begin reclaiming what we have lost, you will become legend. If you fail, the last light of civilization will go out.
releases.quote: Guardians are fighting on Earth and beyond. Join them. Your Ghost will guide you. I only hope he chose wisely.

characters.name: The Speaker
characters.title: Voice of the Traveler
characters.description: Wise leader of the Last City who strives for peace and unification. He wholeheartedly believes in the power of the Traveler to save Humanity and acts as a guide to Guardians on their journies to better understand the Light.

characters.name: Commander Zavala
characters.title: Titan Vanguard Leader
characters.description: An Awoken Titan who serves as the leader of military operations in the Tower. His first priority is to defend the Last City above all else, and is often distrustful of any source of great power that does not come from the Traveler.

characters.name: Cayde-6
characters.title: Hunter Vanguard Leader
characters.description: Makes up his own rules, reckless, and always ready with a joke. While he can sometimes be a wildcard and tends to get himself in trouble, he gives it his all and stays true to his friends.

characters.name: Ikora Rey
characters.title: Warlock Vanguard Leader
characters.description: A Warlock of great wisdom and immense power in the Light, and once one of the fiercest competitors in the Crucible. She acts as a balance between Zavala and Cayde-6, who often don't see eye to eye.

characters.name: Exo Stranger
characters.description: A mysterious agent who has a vested interest in seeing you succeed in your fight against the Darkness, and is very, very short on time.

releases.title: The Dark Below
releases.synopsis: After years hiding amongst the Hive shadows, a new character, Eris, has come forth bearing an ominous warning: Beneath the surface of the Moon, a dark god has answered centuries of prayer, and a dark army has risen. Explore the true depths of the Hellmouth. Stop the dark Hive ritual and survive.
releases.quote: Six of us went down into that pit. I was vain enough to believe we could defeat Crota.

characters.name: Eris Morn
characters.title: Former Hunter
characters.description: Sole survivor of a failed assassination mission against Crota. Lost beneath the Moon's surface for years, she has emerged vastly changed. She has become an expert in the ways of the Hive and is now obsessed with seeing Crota defeated once and for all.

characters.name: Crota
characters.title: Son of Oryx
characters.description: Ancient and powerful Hive Prince who arrived at Earth's Moon and earned the title "Light-Destroyer" during his brutal quest for power and glory in order to return home triumphant after being exiled by his father.

releases.title: House of Wolves
releases.synopsis: The Guardians have grown strong, and now the Queen of the Awoken has called upon them to hunt down the House of Wolves, Fallen subjects once loyal to the Queen before their violent rebellion. Their leader, a Fallen Captain known as Skolas, seeks to bring all of the Fallen Houses under his command. Meet with the Queen's emissaries at Vestian Outpost in the Reef. Hunt down their Fallen betrayers and earn great rewards.
releases.quote: I was House Judgment scribe to House Wolves. Skolas was vicious, even for a Fallen Kell. I could not stomach his hate.

characters.name: Mara Sov
characters.title: Queen of the Awoken
characters.description: Ruler of the Awoken people and the Reef. After an assassination attempt by her former Wolf guards that resulted in heavy Awoken casualties, she has called upon the Guardian to help tracking down the instigators.

characters.name: Petra Venj
characters.title: Queen's Wrath
characters.description: An accomplished soldier in the Queen's army, she now bears the title of Queen's Wrath and serves as emmissary to the Guardian. She has taken charge of the efforts to put a stop to the House of Wolves.

characters.name: Variks, the Loyal
characters.title: House of Judgement Scribe
characters.description: One of the last remaining members of the House of Judgement, he helped to capture Skolas, his former Kell, by betraying him during the Reef Wars. Since then he has sworn loyalty to the Mara Sov and is now the Warden of the Awoken's Prison of Elders.

characters.name: Skolas
characters.title: Kell, House of Wolves
characters.description: Claimed leadership of the House of Wolves before his imprisonment at the end of the Reef Wars. Having broken out of the Prison of Elders, he is now on a mission to unite all Fallen Houses under his command at any cost.

releases.title: The Taken King
releases.synopsis: A massive Hive Dreadnaught ship looms in the rings of Saturn. Oryx, The Taken King has arrived in our solar system, bringing with him a corrupted "Taken" army to exact revenge on the Guardians who destroyed his son Crota, and to consume our worlds. Arm yourself with newfound abilities, weapons, and gear. Defeat the Taken hordes. Make your way aboard the Dreadnaught, and face Oryx himself within his inner sanctum.
releases.quote: You… are the last hope of the Light? I have taken entire worlds. You are not worthy to face me.

characters.name: Eris Morn
characters.title: Crota's Bane
characters.description: Eris' deep knowledge of Hive magic and rituals was instrumental in bringing down Crota, and now she has turned her attention to Oryx in order to fully avenge her fallen comrades.

characters.name: Cayde-6
characters.title: Hunter Vanguard Leader
characters.description: Makes up his own rules, reckless, and always ready with a joke. While he can sometimes be a wildcard and a bit unorthodox, those are the type of skills that just may come in handy when facing a threat of this level.

characters.name: Oryx
characters.title: The Taken King
characters.description: One of the original founders of the Hive race, true believer in the power of Sword Logic and unyielding in his conquest to understand the cosmos. Now with Crota dead by your hand, Oryx is coming to claim his revenge, armed with a dark power beyond anything you've yet had to face.

releases.title: Rise of Iron
releases.synopsis: The wall that stood for centuries along the Cosmodrome's southern border has collapsed. Fallen mutants now scavenge the tombs of the Golden Age, and the technology they have unearthed in the wastes is more dangerous than even they understand. Join Lord Saladin. Journey into the Plaguelands. Learn the fate of the Iron Lords and stop the growing threat before it is too late.
releases.quote: The Iron Lords left an oath unfulfilled. The Guardians will see it through.

characters.name: Lord Saladin
characters.title: The Last Iron Lord
characters.description: Before the City and the Vanguard, there were the Iron Lords. Blessed by the Traveler's Light, these brave warriors dedicated themselves to defending humanity and rebuilding a lost civilization. From their mountain fortress on Felwinter Peak, the Iron Lords ranged across the planet, battling the Darkness and protecting the survivors of the Collapse. But then they encountered an enemy they could not defeat. Now Lord Saladin, the last Iron Lord, honors the memories of his lost brothers and sisters. And he waits, because he knows that someday the Ironsbane will return.

releases.title: The Red War
releases.synopsis: Humanity's last safe city has fallen to an overwhelming invasion force led by Ghaul, the imposing commander of the brutal Red Legion. He has stripped the city’s Guardians of their power, and forced the survivors to flee. You will venture to mysterious, unexplored worlds of our solar system to discover an arsenal of weapons and devastating new combat abilities. To defeat the Red Legion and confront Ghaul, you must reunite humanity’s scattered heroes, stand together, and fight back to reclaim our home.
releases.synopsisFull:
Alerted by a Cabal distress signal transmitted during the assault on the Dreadnought, Dominus Ghaul gathered his Red Legion for a surprise attack on the Last City. As the Tower fell, the Speaker was taken captive and a massive aircraft latched onto the Traveler, severing Guardians' connection to the Light. To ensure total victory, Ghaul moved his ship "The Almighty" in place to begin the process of consuming Mercury to generate a beam to destroy the Sun itself.

After barely surviving an encounter with Ghaul, the Guardian was guided by Suraya Hawthorne to the Farm, where refugee Guardians were gathering. A nearby Shard of the Traveler was enough to empower the Guardian, and they traveled to Nessus, Titan, and Io to search for Cayde-6, Ikora, and Zavala and reunite the Vanguard.

Back at the Farm, the Vanguard formulated and put into motion a plan to disable The Almighty and launch a counter-assault to liberate the Last City. After interrogating and killing the Speaker, Ghaul forcibly claimed the power of the Light from the traveler. In a final face-off, The Guardian managed to overpower Ghaul. After he is killed he resurrects and tries to speak with the Traveler directly, which finally awakens and shatters the Cabal restrains, destroying Ghaul in the process.

The shockwave emanating from the Traveler as it awoke echoed out into the far reaches of space, where it alerted an ancient enemy to its presence...
releases.quote: You're not brave. You've merely forgotten the fear of death. Allow me to reacquaint you.

characters.name: Dominus Ghaul
characters.title: Self-proclaimed Leader of the Cabal
characters.description: After transforming the Cabal into the ultimate war machine, Ghaul has his sights set on conquering the Traveler and showing it the error of its ways in choosing Humanity over the Cabal to bless with the power of the Light.

characters.name: The Speaker
characters.title: Voice of the Traveler
characters.description: Wise leader of the Last City who strives for peace and unification. He wholeheartedly believes in the power of the Traveler to save Humanity and acts as a guide to Guardians on their journies to better understand the Light.

characters.name: Suraya Hawthorne
characters.description: Fed up with rules and politics of the Last City, she lives outside the walls on her own. She believes that aiding survivors of the attack is more important than trying to take back the City, but isn't afraid to provide support where she is needed.

characters.name: Commander Zavala
characters.title: Titan Vanguard Leader
characters.description: An Awoken Titan who serves as the leader of military operations in the Tower. His first priority is to defend the Last City above all else, and the loss of the Light leaves him doubting himself when he no longer has the means to protect as he once did.

characters.name: Cayde-6
characters.title: Hunter Vanguard Leader
characters.description: Makes up his own rules, reckless, and always ready with a joke. While he can sometimes be a wildcard and tends to get himself in trouble, he gives it his all and stays true to his friends.

characters.name: Ikora Rey
characters.title: Warlock Vanguard Leader
characters.description: A Warlock of great wisdom and immense power in the Light, and once one of the fiercest competitors in the Crucible. She acts as a balance between Zavala and Cayde-6, who often don't see eye to eye.

releases.title: Curse of Osiris
releases.synopsis: After the defeat of the Red Legion, the battered Last City starts to rebuild all they lost. However, when a terrible Vex plot threatens Mercury, the legendary Warlock Osiris calls upon the Guardian to prevent the Vex from assimilating the entire universe.
releases.synopsisFull:
Osiris, the former Warlock Vanguard and exile from the Last City, sought to thwart Panoptes, the Infinite Mind, from using simulations to achieve total victory for the Vex.

Trapped within a Vex simulation engine called the Infinite Forest, Osiris was separated from his Ghost Sagira. She narrowly managed to escape, and then recruited the Guardian to re-enter the Forest with the help of Ikora and locate Osiris via echoes he had scattered throughout the simulation.

Osiris and the Guardian managed to defeat Panoptes, after which Osiris chose to remain in the forest to use its simulations for humanity's gain.
releases.quote: We can't stay here.... If the Vex succeed, it's the end of everything.

characters.name: Osiris
characters.title: Exiled Vanguard Commander
characters.description: Obsessed with the Vex and their simulations of various futures, his research has brought him to Mercury. He is driven to explore the Infinite Forest by the knowledge that the Vex may be on the verge of discovering a path to a future where they destroy all other lifeforms.

releases.title: Warmind
releases.synopsis: Ana Bray, a Guardian long thought lost, searches for a connection to her past…one that could be lost forever on the polar ice caps of Mars. As Golden Age warsats begin slamming into the ice, the glaciers begin to thaw, revealing the core of the Warmind Rasputin - and an ancient Hive army bent on its destruction. Now free, the Hive swarm in service to their god Xol. Help Ana discover her past and destroy the Hive's gargantuan worm-god before it is too late.
releases.synopsisFull:
The Guardian is en route to Mars when they receive an urgent distress call from Ana Bray, Hunter and descendent of a Golden Age lineage. She has been nearing the end of her search for Rasputin, the Golden Age Warmind AI, but the shockwave from the awakening of the Traveler at the end of the Red War has caused an army of Hive to emerge from the beneath the planets frozen surface.

With the Hive now threatening the core of Rasputin itself, Ana and the Guardian work together to access the security system and get into the central Mindlab facility. Ana attempts to contact Rapsutin directly with a request for aid, and he responds by providing a powerful weapon called the Valkyrie.

With this new power the Guardian is able to first defeat the herald of Xol, Nokris, and finally Xol himself. With the facilty finally safe from Hive danger, they finally gain access to the inner chamber of Rasputin's central core. He proclaims that he will never again let a threat go unseen; he will safeguard humanity, but only on his own terms.
releases.quote: Guardians aren't supposed to investigate their past. That's the rule. But I'm not good with rules. Not when there's this much at stake.

characters.name: Rasputin
characters.title: Golden Age Warmind
characters.description: Military artificial intelligence developed by the Clovis Bray Corporation as an interplanetary defense system. Its primary directive is to protect Humanity, and it will use all resources at its disposal to ensure it accomplishes its mission no matter what stands in its way.

characters.name: Ana Bray
characters.description: A Hunter who abandoned the Last City intent on uncovering the mysteries of her past and the secrets of Clovis Bray from the Golden Age. After a lengthy search across the system for Rasputin she's finally on the verge of making contact, despite Zavala's warnings.

characters.name: Xol, Will of the Thousands
characters.title: Worm God
characters.description: One of the ancient paracausal creatures that helped bring about the Hive, Xol has remained hidden and dormant beneath the surface of Mars since the Collapse. The Traveler's recent awakening has finally caused him to resurface, causing havoc across the planet.

releases.title: Forsaken
releases.synopsis:
The Reef has fallen to lawlessness, and now the most-wanted criminals in the galaxy - the Barons & Uldren Sov - have organized a high-stakes jailbreak at the Prison of Elders. You and Cayde-6 have been sent in to bring law and order back to the embattled facility, but things do not go to plan. Facing insurmountable odds, Cayde-6 ends up paying the ultimate price.

Beyond the Vanguard's authority, the Guardian ventures into the Reef alone to take justice into their own hands and discover the root of the sinister forces at play.
releases.synopsisFull:
Petra Venj recruits the Guardian and Cayde-6 to travel to the Reef and help secure a breakout from the Prison of Elders. They discover that this is no simple prison break however, and Cayde ends up facing off against a horde of strange variant of Fallen called Scorn. They overpower him and manage to destroy his Ghost, leaving him vulnerable to be killed by Uldren Sov.

Without the support of the Vanguard, the Guardian sets out alone to the Tangled shore to hunt down Uldren and his Scorn in order to bring them to justice. An unexpected ally is found in the Spider, a Fallen crime lord who controls the Shore, and together with Petra manage to track down and eliminate all of the Scorned Barons who escaped from the prison, all the while trying to catch up with Uldren as he continues a desparate search for his lost sister Mara.

Petra and the Guardian follow Uldren as he opens a gateway to the Dreaming City, the hidden Awoken homeland. Expecting to finally be reunited with his sister, instead find himself tricked and corrupted by a horrific dragon-like Ahamkara name Riven who had been Taken by Oryx. The Guardian manages to destroy the Voice of Riven, and then kill a severly weakened Uldren, avenging Cayde at last.
releases.quote: It's time to end this. For Cayde.

characters.name: Cayde-6
characters.title: Hunter Vanguard Leader
characters.description: Following the Red War, Cayde-6 has been impatient to get back out in the field. Responding to a call for aid from Petra Venj, he finds out that he's been dealt a bad hand as he ends up outnumbered by Uldren Sov and his new Scorned Barons.

characters.name: Petra Venj
characters.title: Queen's Wrath
characters.description: Since the Queen's disappearance during the Taken War, Petra has been leading the Awoken of the Reef as Acting Regent-Commander. She still believes that Mara Sov is out there somewhere, but after the catastrophe at the Prison of Elders she is now fully dedicated to helping avenge Cayde-6.

characters.name: Uldren Sov
characters.title: The Mad Prince
characters.description: Driven to madness by the loss of his sister, he betrayed his people and has begun a reign of terror throughout the Reef with Fikrul, with whom he shares a strange connection. He will go to any lengths to be able to see Mara again.

characters.name: Fikrul, the Fanatic
characters.title: The Heretic
characters.description: An outcast for his condemnation of the Great Machine. He has a strange and terrible power to bring dead Fallen back to life as a twisted form of immortality. He believes that this power he wields is the next great step in their evolution.

characters.name: Spider
characters.title: The Shore's Only Law
characters.description: Ruthless leader of a Fallen crime syndicate, he's not afraid to work alongside anyone who will further his empire. Fikrul's Scorn are cutting into his profits, so it will be necessary to form an unlikely partnership to operate in the Tangled Shore.

entries.title: Season of the Forge
entries.synopsis:
Guardians met Ada-1, reclusive Exo and curator of the weapon foundry called The Black Armory. Though distrustful of Lightbearers, Ada needed help to recover her Forges, lost during the Red War.

Guardians recovered all four Armor forges and unearthed secrets of Ada's own past, rekindling the Armory's operations and changing Ada's outlook on those who wield the Light.

characters.name: Ada-1
characters.title: Curator of the Black Armory
characters.description: Descended from a family of weaponsmiths during the Golden Age, she is an expert at crafting advanced weaponry, though is distrustful of Guardians after experiencing terrible losses at the hands of Warlords during the Dark Age after the Collapse.

entries.title: Season of the Drifter
entries.synopsis:
The Drifter upped the ante on his Gambit, much to the Vanguard's disappointment. Guardians made a choice, to spy on the Drifter or to work more closely with him.

Guardians learned bits of Drifter's past: that the Nine are patrons of his endeavors, and that he knew their Emissary days past, when both were different people.

characters.name: The Drifter
characters.title: Rogue Lightbearer
characters.description: Organizer of Gambit, he is a shady character with a winding past and a peculiar interest in the Taken. You only live as long as he has if you're willing to do anything to survive. He doesn't think much of the Traveler or the Vanguard and tends to keep to himself.

characters.name: Emissary of the Nine
characters.description: A mysterious figure that speaks for the Nine, who are an enigmatic group of strange beings. The Nine have seen the raw power of Darkness and are interested in the Drifter and his affinity for Darkness while still retaining his Light.

entries.title: Season of Opulence
entries.synopsis:
Emperor Calus, disgraced former leader of the Cabal, enticed Guardians back to his Leviathan ship with promises of power, all in the hopes that he could sway them to his clandestine ranks as a Shadow.

The Guardians competed in Calus's Menagerie and claimed their spoils, but their allegiances remained steadfast.

characters.name: Emperor Calus
characters.title: The True Emperor
characters.description: Former emperor of the Cabal, returned to power. After being exiled by Dominus Ghaul, he roamed the galaxy until arriving back at Sol. He is looking to expand his army to prepare the way for a desolate future revealed to him in a vision.

releases.title: Shadowkeep
releases.synopsis:
An ancient enemy grows ever closer, and as the heroes of the last safe city turn their attention to the frontiers of our galaxy, new Nightmares emerge from beneath the lunar surface.

Heed Eris Morn's call and stand against the Hive swarm. Construct an arsenal out of Nightmare Essence and destroy the evil lurking in the Pit of Heresy and Garden of Salvation.
releases.quote: Don't you recognize us? We are not your friend. We are not your enemy. We are your… salvation.

characters.name: Eris Morn
characters.title: Crota's Bane
characters.description: Her quest against the Hive seemingly endless, Eris has finally returned to the Moon and found that she is haunted by ghosts of her lost fireteam. The Nightmares she faces appear to be a result of this new breed of Hive that feed off of some deeper, more terrible power.

actions.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
actions.description: Acquired upon reaching the Tower after New Light Quest

entries.title: Season of the Undying
entries.synopsis:
The Vex, spurred by the reactivation of the Pyramid on Earth's moon, opened a portal to the Black Garden. Their forces spewed forth, assaulting the lunar surface.

Ikora Rey and the Guardian launched offensives into the Garden, using a portal of Ikora's creation to track and destroy the Vex leader: the Undying Mind. The Guardian recovered a relic of Darkness from within the Garden.

characters.name: Ikora Rey
characters.title: Warlock Vanguard Leader
characters.description: Working alongside Eris Morn and the Guardian, Ikora came up with a portal that could locate the source of the Vex invasion, the Undying Mind. After killing it across two dozen timelines, she's recruited fireteams from across the City to wipe out all versions of it it for good.

entries.title: Season of Dawn
entries.synopsis:
Osiris exited the Infinite Forest with a portent of humanity's doom, foreseen in the simulations. He learned the remains of the Red Legion had taken the Sundial, a failed time-travel experiment of his own invention.

The Guardians fought the Cabal and their Psion Council to stop them from rewriting history, then used the same methods to save the lost Guardian Saint-14 from his death in the past.

characters.name: Osiris
characters.title: Exiled Vanguard Commander
characters.description: Returning from the Infinite Forest, Osiris has used his fascination for Vex technology to see into possible futures. In every single simulated future he has explored, he sees a dark future for Humanity in which the Last City lies in ruin with a monolithic structure floating above it.

characters.name: Saint-14
characters.title: Hero of Six Fronts
characters.description: A legendary Titan who had followed Osiris into the Infinite Forest only to be lost for centuries in the ever-shifting timelines. After destroying an untold number of Vex he was eventually killed, but with the help of the Sundial the Guardian managed to arrive in time to save Saint-14. Now he has returned to a very different world from the one he left.

entries.title: Season of the Worthy
entries.synopsis:
With their plans for the Sundial foiled, the Legion made a desperate play for revenge on humanity. They launched the derelict Almighty, former pride of Ghaul's fleet, at the Last City.

Ana Bray and the Vanguard put aside their differences and made a plan to use Rasputin's Warsat network to neutralize the threat. The Guardians powered Rasputin's arsenal, and the Warmind destroyed the Almighty.

characters.name: Rasputin
characters.title: Golden Age Warmind
characters.description: Following the eradication of the Hive on Mars, Rasputin seems willing to learn from the errors of his past, including abandoning Humanity during the Collapse. He uncovers that the Black Fleet has been amassing in secret in the outer reaches of the Solar System, and this time is ready to stand with the Vanguard.

characters.name: Ana Bray
characters.title: Voice of Rasputin
characters.description: Having helped create Rasputin back in the Golden Age, she has a special connection to the Warmind. She convinces Zavala that they need Rasputin's help to take out the Almighty, and goes to work with the Guardian to help reclaim bunkers across the system that Rasputin needs to assault the Almighty.

entries.title: Season of Arrivals
entries.synopsis:
The Black Fleet, humanity's ancient foe, returned to our system and knocked out Rasputin's defenses with trivial ease. The Vanguard evacuated some stellar bodies as the Pyramids descended on them.

Guardians worked with Eris Morn to translate cryptic messages from the Pyramids while battling back the enemies of humanity, now emboldened by the growing shadow enveloping humanity.

characters.name: The Drifter
characters.title: Rogue Lightbearer
characters.description: Having extensive experience with both Light and Dark in his past, he knows our perspective of them is limited. Light and Dark are not forces strictly bound to good and evil, nor is the invading Black Fleet itself the true master of Darkness.

characters.name: Savathûn
characters.title: The Witch Queen
characters.description: Sister to the great Oryx himself, she is the Hive god of cunning and secrets. After the death of Xol, Nokris, with his heretical knowledge of Hive Necromancy, has joined her ranks, suggesting she may be forming a new vile scheme.

releases.title: Beyond Light
releases.synopsis:
Humanity's ancient foe has returned. As the Black Fleet fills the sky, a strange power pulls friend and foe alike to the ruins of Europa, and a new Kell wields the gift of Darkness to unite the Fallen.

Work with the Exo Stranger to stop Eramis, Kell of Darkness, in a new story campaign. Master Stasis subclasses and unlock the secrets of the Deep Stone Crypt raid.
releases.quote: The line between Light and Dark is so very thin...let's cross it together.

characters.name: Exo Stranger
characters.title: A Link to the Future
characters.description: After assisting the Guardian in destroying the Black Heart years ago, the Stranger is back after continuing to see many timelines where the forces of the Darkness win, and is doing all she can to stop it. She teaches others such as the Drifter, Eris Morn, and even the Guardian themselves to use the Dark power of Stasis without becoming corrupted.

characters.name: Eramis
characters.title: Kell of Darkness
characters.description: Filled with hatred from past failures, she finds a new power in the Black Fleet and wields Stasis unchecked. She leads a new rising group of Fallen that call themselves House Salvation, after Eramis' belief that their new powers will free them from the fate of the Great Machine.

characters.name: Variks, the Loyal
characters.title: House of Judgement Scribe
characters.description: Not seen since fleeing the Reef after causing the riot at the Prison of Elders. After working with Eramis to build a new home for the Fallen on Europa, he watched as she became corrupted by Stasis and now he calls for help as she becomes increasingly instable.

entries.title: Season of the Hunt
entries.synopsis:
As planets vanished, Xivu Arath, the Hive god of war, moved to seize power. Osiris walked a dangerous path to learn of this plot; his Ghost, Sagira, paid the ultimate price.

The Guardian met an unexpected ally—Uldren Sov, murderer of Cayde-6. reborn as Crow; a Guardian in the Spider's employ. The Guardian foiled Xivu's plans and bargained with the Spider to buy Crow's freedom.

characters.name: Osiris
characters.title: Exiled Vanguard Commander
characters.description: Intent on investigating the Black Fleet after his vision of one of the ships attacking the Last City, he ends up cornered by Xivu Arath's emissary on the Moon. His Ghost Sagira sacrifices herself to allow him to escape with his life, but he has now lost his connection to the Light, leaving him vulnerable.

characters.name: Crow
characters.title: Rogue Hunter
characters.description: As a newly-risen Guardian, he does not have any memories of his past life as Uldren Sov. His personality is also vastly different; No longer the cruel and bitter prince, but valuable ally who sees the good in everyone. After having been forced to work for Spider, he's still learning what his path as a Guardian truly is.

entries.title: Season of the Chosen
entries.synopsis:
Caiatl, Empress of the Cabal, led her fleet to the Sol system and offered a deal to Zavala: swear fealty, and defeat the Hive together. The commander refused.

The Guardian undermined Caiatl's attempts to form a war council, defeating her champions in ritual combat. Cabal renegades attempted to kill Zavala, but Crow foiled the plot, revealing his identity in the process. Zavala and Caiatl agreed on a truce.

characters.name: Caiatl
characters.title: Empress of the Cabal
characters.description: Arriving in Sol after fleeing from the Cabal homeworld of Torobotl after a Hive invasion, she calls for all remaining Cabal forces to join her. Compared to her father Calus she is a fair and honorable ruler, and unlike Ghaul does not want to take the Light but instead ally with the Vanguard, who she recognizes as respected leaders.

entries.title: Season of the Splicer
entries.synopsis:
As a Vex simulation plunged the Last City into darkness, the Vanguard turned to the Eliksni Splicer, Mithrax, for aid. In return, Ikora offered to shelter House Light within the City's walls—a controversial decision. With Mithrax's help, the Guardians learned to delve deep into the Vex network. There, they discovered the true mastermind behind the Endless Night: Quria, Blade Transform.

After defeating Quria as well as a treasonous Vex invasion of the Last City led by faction leader Lakshmi-2, the Guardians successfully lifted the Endless Night. Mithrax and the House Light remain in the Eliksni Quarter as allies of the Vanguard.

characters.name: Mithrax
characters.title: Kell of Light
characters.description: Previously spared his life by the Guardian on Titan, he has created the House of Light with a mission of working alongside Guardians and ending the conflict between the Eliksni and Humanity. With extensive experience in an array of technologies as a Splicer, Mithrax has unique insights into how the Vex work and is fast becoming a key ally to the City, along with the rest of the House of Light.

entries.title: Season of the Lost
entries.synopsis:
After Saint-14, Crow, and the Guardian raced to the Dreaming City to confront Osiris, Savathûn revealed the truth: for months, she had assumed Osiris's identity sowing distrust and chaos within the Vanguard and beyond. After a confrontation, the Witch Queen restored Crow's memories of his days as Uldren Sov. Now faced with his past, Crow retreated into solitude.

Queen Mara Sov struck a bargain where, in exchange for being freed from her worm, Savathûn would reveal the secrets of the Darkness. Intent on lifting the curse from the Dreaming City, Mara planned to kill her nemesis, but just as the separation ceremony completed, Savathûn escaped, her whereabouts unknown.

characters.name: Mara Sov
characters.title: Queen of the Awoken
characters.description: Freshly returned from the Ascendant Plane with the help of Techeuns led by Petra Venj. While she ultimately doesn't trust Savathûn, she believes that agreeing to the deal is worth the risk. After reaquanting herself with her brother, now known as Crow, Mara will have to rebuild their relationship into something new, which may require change in herself along the way.

characters.name: Savathûn
characters.title: The Witch Queen
characters.description: Ever the trickster, the Hive god of cunning and secrets never lets her grand designs be fully known. She took the guise of Osiris in his moment of weakness in order to carry out her plan while hiding from Xivu Arath, and says that she has been providing support to the Guardian and orchestrating their path from the shadows for a long time. But what is her end goal, and can you really trust any of her claims?

releases.title: The Witch Queen
releases.synopsis:
Delve into Savathun's twisted throne world to uncover the mystery of how she and her Lucent Brood stole the Light.

Learn the secrets required to craft all-new weapons, a new weapon archetype, and take back the Light.
releases.quote: She is not as foolhardy as her brother. She would never risk a direct confrontation. We will know her next move only when she makes it - and only if we're wise enough to recognize it.

characters.name: Savathûn
characters.title: The Witch Queen
characters.description: Her plans now in motion in earnest, it's not clear if there is anything that can be done to stop them. After being separated from her worm she is now free of the influence of the Witness, but has also lost the gift of immortality that the worm promised. However, having somehow convinced the Traveler to bestow Light upon her, Savathûn's Throne World echoes that newfound power and she raises a new breed of Hive that have Ghosts.

characters.name: Fynch
characters.title: Conscientious Objector
characters.description: Originally the Ghost of a Hive Knight, he has defected from the Lucent Brood after seeing them using Light against other Guardians. Afraid of being discovered, he's eager to work with the Guardian to uncover what is really going on in Savathûn's Throne World.

entries.title: Season of the Risen
entries.synopsis:
Savathun emerged with an army of Lucent Hive and threatened the source of the Guardian's power. To contend with the Witch Queen, the Vanguard relied on their fragile alliance with Empress Caiatl.

Wielding the Cabal's Light-supressing technology, Guardians explored the minds of the Witch Queen's soldiers to find the intel needed to prevent her plans from coming to fruition.

characters.name: Lord Saladin, Valus Forge
characters.title: The Last Iron Lord
characters.description: When Caiatl demands the death of Crow after he accidentally kills one of Caiatl's psions, Lord Saladin offers to take his place instead. Cabal reward bravery in the face of death, and so Caiatl instead says he is to join her War Council until the end of his days.

entries.title: Season of the Haunted
entries.synopsis:
The Leviathan returned, now corrupted by Nightmares from humanity's past. With its sights set on the Moon's dormany Pyramid ship, Guardians intervened before Calus could claim its power.

In the end, the Leviathan was severed from the Pyramid permanantly. But even as the Nightmares began to fade, Calus ensured his return and threatened the Vanguard with the arrival of the Witness.

characters.name: Calus
characters.title: Title
characters.description: A shadow of his former glory, Calus is on a mission to begin his ascension to a Disciple of the Witness. While attempting to gain control of the Pyramid ship, he is tormented by his own personal Nightmare that takes the shape of his daughter Caiatl. His mind remains divided: one side tortured by the people of his past life, the other craving the glory of being a Disciple.

characters.name: Caiatl
characters.title: Empress of the Cabal
characters.description: With the invasion of Torobotl fresh in her mind, she is wary of Eris Morn's Hive sorcery, but trying to face the Nightmare of her old role model, Dominus Ghaul, alone proves futile. After Eris helps the Empress explore her fears, Caiatl realizes that she can help create a better future for the Cabal than their previous leaders.

entries.title: Season of Plunder
entries.synopsis:
Frozen on Europa since her defeat, Eramis had been mysteriously released from her icy shackles. To stop her and the Eliksni pirate crew she had assembled, Guardians formed a crew of their own.

Guardians set sail aboard Spider's ship, charting the stars in search of lost relics that promised to grant Eramis terrifying power...should she plunder them first.

characters.name: Eramis
characters.title: Kell of Darkness
characters.description: Freed from the Stasis prison by whispers of the Witness, she is now rallying a crew to try to locate Dark Age relics. She looks down on Mithrax's House of Light and their alliance with the City, and still believes that the only way for the Fallen to restore peace is through violence.

entries.title: Season of the Seraph
entries.synopsis: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to rebuild the Warmind, Rasputin. To that end, we need to infiltrate BrayTech facilities in exotic locales throughout the system to steal back long-lost portions of Rasputin's conciousness. These entities are known as the Seraphs.

characters.name: Rasputin
characters.title: Golden Age Warmind
characters.description: After fatal damage during the initial invasion of the Black Fleet, Ana Bray worked for months to rebuild Rapsutin's systems and eventually succeeded in not only restoring him, but bringing him closer to Humanity. At the same time, with as much power as Rasputin has throughout the system, there are others who want to take control of it and use it for their own plans.

releases.title: Lightfall
releases.synopsis:
The Witness has arrived, threatening the City, The Traveler, and all of Sol. Aided by its newest disciple, Emperor Calus, the Witness aims to bring about a second collapse.

Race Emperor Calus to the edge of the solar system. Learn the ways of the Cloud Striders, wield Strand, a new power of the Darkness, and bring an end to Calus' reign.

entries.title: Season of Defiance
entries.synopsis:
In the aftermath of the Witness's attack, the Vanguard calls upon its closest allies. The Guardian must master the righteous powers of the Awoken if they hope to stand against the encroaching Shadow Legion.

Tear through the Ascendant Plane and use the mysterious abilities of the Queensguard to breach the Pyramid outposts and banish Calus's troops. Fight for the freedom of your allies and the very future of Earth.

entries.title: Season of the Deep
entries.synopsis: Saturn's missing moon of Titan has returned, overrun with Taken and Hive searching for something at the bottom of its methane ocean. Guardians must follow them into the deep and beyond to uncover ancient secrets.

entries.title: Season of the Witch
entries.synopsis:
Become a master of the arcane arts as you work with Eris Morn to fulfill a dangerous bargain with Immaru, the Witch Queen's Ghost. Ascend Savathun's Spire and delve into her Altars of Summoning to explore her dark rituals and esoteric secrets.

Finally, help Eris unleash her inner Hive in a desperate gambit to save Earth and the Traveler from the Witness's dominion.

entries.title: Season of the Wish
entries.synopsis: Venture into Riven's Lair to recover her lost clutch in exchange for her granting one final wish: the opening of a path to the Witness.

releases.title: The Final Shape
releases.synopsis:
The Final Shape looms—a nightmarish calcification of reality into the Witness's twisted design.

Embark on a perilous journey into the heart of the Traveler, rally the Vanguard, and end the War of Light and Darkness.

entries.title: Episode: Echoes
entries.synopsis:
In the aftermath of the Witness's death, explore novel paracausal mysteries.

Delve into the core of the living planet Nessus, and pursue a ruthless new threat with a familiar face.

entries.title: Episode: Revenant
entries.synopsis:
Fikrul returns, wielding an Echo with the power to twist living Eliksni to his own ends.

Step into the role of Slayer Baron, raise the banner of House Light, and wield the paracausal powers of Eido's tonics against them.

entries.title: Episode: Heresy
entries.synopsis:
The Dreadnought lives again and surges with Taken corruption threatening to spread throughout Sol.

You must find the resolve and ambition to repel the Taken.

Become a conduit of corrosive power—the bulwark against chaos—and break the taken with your will.

releases.title: The Edge of Fate
releases.synopsis: Follow the invitation. Travel to Keplar and uncover the nature of the mysterious signal emanating from this drifting rim-world. / Something is calling. A message arrives that draws the Vanguard to a planetoid on the edge of the solar system. Hunt down the source of our invitation, and uncover a truth that will redefine our future.

releases.title: Renegades
releases.synopsis: Dive into the criminal underworld and take down an evil empire. Venture into a lawless frontier and reveal deeper mysteries about a new Dredgen in Sol. Build your power, credits, and reputation.
